item.text: {"ticker":"KO","status":"success","report":"This report is for educational use only and is not financial advice. StockValuation.io returned a successful FCFF, three-stage DCF for The Coca-Cola Company in USD. The MCP estimated value per share is $41.20, with value of equity at $177.28B and market quote at $81.48. Growth uses 3.85% revenue growth for years 2-5, moving toward 4.60% in the terminal year. Margins start from a 38.48% base, use 38.00% next year, and converge to a 30.73% target, above the cited 17.27% industry base margin. Reinvestment is driven by sales-to-capital of 2.90x in years 1-5 and 1.67x in years 6-10, with terminal reinvestment at 47.76%. Cost of capital starts at 7.27% and converges to 9.63%, using a 4.60% risk-free rate and Damodaran ERP/country-risk reference data. Terminal value uses 4.60% terminal growth, $11.09B terminal cash flow, $220.45B terminal value, and $69.74B present value of terminal value. Data caveats: rates are percentages, sales-to-capital is a multiple, Yahoo Finance data can be missing or stale, Damodaran mapping is to beveragesoft with 2026 data and 0.574 confidence, and the projection was upgraded to THREE_STAGE because the first-pass market-value gap was materially outside the service band."}
